Three notices, one notice, empty, and the clear action hovered and pressed. Rendered from the cupertino dark look's tokens; derived, not compared with a real screen.
gaps: No platform capture: every look is rendered from its own tokens (Windows 11 Fluent / v3 flat, libadwaita 1.5, Apple HIG, Material 3 baseline) and nothing was measured against a real screen or the native control

No profile-specific drawing was added: the control draws through the shared tokens, so where a platform's own widget has another shape (for example a Fluent InfoBar, an Adwaita banner, an iOS notification) this is the shared Material-derived shape in that look's colours, type and radii
Only the clear action is driven: a notice row's hover, its dismiss and its action are not captured
The list is 260 tall and scrolls: the third notice is partly below the fold in the three-notice cell
